$note.baseHiddenChance: Chance an enemy hides its exact move while still showing its stance, before attribute reductions.
$note.wisdomReduction: Reduction in hidden intent chance for each point of Wisdom.
$note.intelligenceReduction: Reduction in hidden intent chance for each point of Intelligence.
$note.minimumHiddenChance: Lowest allowed chance an enemy hides its exact move after attribute reductions.
$note.maximumHiddenChance: Highest allowed chance an enemy hides its exact move after attribute reductions.
